blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In a country where millions live in poverty and struggle to make ends meet, the cost of holding a wake and burying a loved one can be overwhelming, especially for families still burdened by hospital bills and debts after prolonged medical treatment. Government data showed that 9.7% of the Philippine population, or 11.1 million Filipinos, were poor in 2025. The poverty threshold for a family of five was P14,634 a month.
